title: 都市デザイン
subtitle: Urban Design
keywords: Visual and Cognitive Characteristics of Space
educationalGoal:
Students will:
1) learn relations between external spaces and activities of various entities.
2) acquire knowledge on basic landscape engineering and landscape theory.
3) acquire knowledge of the concepts and methods for urban design
4)learn how to investigate analyze urban and rural areas and how to appropriately edit the relations of various spatial and social elements.
advice:
This course provides basic knowledge and skills for urban design. We will cover the following materials:

1. recent uraban design trends and needs for urban design, especially in public spaces
2. investigation and analysis of urban and rural areas
3. characteristics of our perception of the visual world and basic landscape theory
4. analysis of the image of the city
5. theory, methods, and examples of urban design in Japan and other countries

Reference materials will be distributed in class as needed. Information on reference books will also be shown in class. Students are expected to make use of these materials and books for review and improving knowledge.
requiredKnowledge: No special knowledge is required to take this course.

3. characteristics of our perception of the visual world and basic landscape theory
